title: Marlboro Bolt-Action Handgun
summary: A brand-inspired hard-surface prop that turns Marlboro's vintage visual language into a fictional bolt-action handgun.
description: This personal study translates the bold geometry, cream-and-red palette, and period character of Marlboro packaging into a fictional weapon. The project moves from hard-surface modelling through material work and presentation, treating the final renders as both a prop showcase and a graphic-design exercise.
coverAlt: Brand-inspired bolt-action handgun presented against a graphic red background

title: HECOR — High-Energy Concentration Orbital Weapon
summary: A speculative orbital weapon developed through modelling, poster design, motion, and fictional technical imagery.
description: Built around the SCP Foundation universe, HECOR explores how one fictional device can be communicated across several visual formats. A 3D model anchors the project, while the poster, animated light study, and thaumaturgical engine image extend the object into a larger imagined system.
coverAlt: Tall technical poster for the fictional HECOR orbital weapon

title: SCP-9001 Site Romero-5 Underground
summary: An underground environment study focused on scene building, architectural scale, and directional light.
description: This environment interprets the domed underground chamber described in SCP-9001. The scene-building and lighting study uses repeated stone structure, patterned surfaces, fog, and a concentrated overhead opening to establish scale and an uncanny ceremonial atmosphere.
coverAlt: Dark domed underground chamber lit by a bright opening overhead

title: Rotten Inside — Banner Series
summary: A four-part banner system for the Backrooms novel series Rotten Inside, combining typographic hierarchy with ominous world-building.
description: The series gives four entries in Rotten Inside a related visual identity while allowing each banner to carry its own place, threat, and mood. Repeated type placement and framing create continuity; changes in imagery, texture, and colour give each chapter a distinct signal.
coverAlt: Graphic banner from the Rotten Inside Backrooms novel series

title: Level PT-1 — Selva de Concreto
summary: A Backrooms environment imagining Selva de Concreto through dense composition, warm haze, and monumental concrete forms.
description: This scene-assembly study focuses on lighting and composition. Third-party environment assets from TheMask Scenebuild Megapack were arranged and lit to shape a humid, overgrown concrete world with a clear path through the frame and a strong sense of depth.
credit: Environment assets: TheMask Scenebuild Megapack. My contribution: scene assembly, lighting, and composition.
coverAlt: Level PT-1 Selva de Concreto title artwork
